name: @nuxt/content4
description: Write your content inside your Nuxt app

scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && nuxt dev playground
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt prepare playground
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run prepack && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.typecheck: npm run dev:prepare && nuxt prepare examples/v3-multi-source && nuxt prepare examples/v3-layers && vue-tsc --noEmit && vue-tsc --noEmit -p playground && vue-tsc --noEmit -p examples/v3-multi-source && vue-tsc --noEmit -p examples/v3-layers
scripts.verify: npm run dev:prepare && npm run prepack && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck
